release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.8

• **Fullscreen Now Playing UI (Minimalist Edge-to-Edge & Full-Bleed Standard Cover)**: Added edge-to-edge Minimalist Now Playing with live synced lyric line preview and oversized transport controls, while keeping Standard mode's classic glass transport panel and utility bar with full-bleed edge-to-edge cover/motion artwork fading behind the UI.
• **Fixed Video Cover Art Pausing Song in Fullscreen**: Added mixWithOthers audio focus isolation on animated cover controllers so entering fullscreen keeps the song playing smoothly alongside looping artwork.
• **Spotify Canvas Support & Minimalist `am-lyrics` Animation**: Extended motion cover resolution to support vertical Spotify Canvas loops and added expressive left-aligned Minimalist lyrics with spring slide, distance blur, and syllable lift.
• **Shazam Recognition (Android & Windows)**: Added native Windows WinMM mic capture + Shazam-style spectral constellation peak fingerprinting (plus optional AudD/webhook lookup) accessible right from Search.
• **Pluggable Lossless Modules + Streaming Fallback, Radio Builder, Daily Replay Mix & 8D Audio**: Added external lossless module configuration & health checks, a multi-artist/song/genre Radio Builder, Daily Replay Mix from your most-played tracks, and Rust DSP 8D 360-degree orbiting audio in Settings.
• **Fixed Android Local Folder Persistence & Scoped Storage Scanning**: Added native Android SAF persisted tree URI picking & DocumentFile audio/LRC traversal with immediate settings disk flush and startup rescan so added FLAC/local folders never vanish or show 0 tracks.
